TITLE:
How many passes?
Count to the end!
NEXT:
Numbers · pictures · passes —
how many fooled you?

EN.민트색 공의 패스만 세어 보세요\n코랄색 공은 빼고!:
Count only the passes of the mint ball.
Ignore the coral ball!
EN.민트색 패스, 몇 번 셌나요?: How many mint passes did you count?
EN.그런데… 혹시\n커다란 별 봤어요?:
But… did you see
the big star?
EN.별이 한가운데를\n지나갔어요!:
A star walked right
through the middle!
EN.뇌는 집중할 것에만\n조명을 비춰요:
Your brain shines a spotlight
only on what you focus on
EN.조명 밖은 눈에 들어와도\n기억에 잘 안 남아요:
Things outside the spotlight reach your eyes
but barely stick in your mind
EN.걸으며 휴대폰을 보면\n차나 자전거를 못 볼 수 있어요:
If you look at your phone while walking,
you might miss a car or a bike
EN.집중은 힘이 세지만\n그만큼 놓치는 것도 있어요:
Focus is powerful,
but it makes you miss things too
